# n8n_data_table (Data Source)

Fetches a single n8n data table by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Data table identifier. Either `id` or `name` must be specified.
- `name` (String) Data table name. Either `id` or `name` must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `columns` (Attributes List) Column definitions for the data table (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the data table was created
- `project_id` (String) Project ID the data table belongs to
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the data table was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Column identifier
- `index` (Number) Column position index
- `name` (String) Column name
- `type` (String) Column data type
